alt: Official NEOM concept render showing two impossibly tall mirrored walls stretching along the Saudi Red Sea coast to the horizon — the planned 170km 'The Line' megacity
story: Saudi Arabia's NEOM halted construction of 'The Line' — a planned 170km mirrored-wall city for 9 million people — after completing just 2.4km of foundation (1.4%), delaying the project until at least 2030 as internal audits put the true cost near $9 trillion.
why_funny: They unveiled billion-dollar CGI of a 170km city for 9 million and physically built less than a kilometre and a half of it.
